recommendation: Keep the commit as a bounded pattern-level fix. Handle any future harmonization of ServiceRequest, Task, or MedicationRequest doNotPerform wording under their own Jira decisions rather than broadening FHIR-13468.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue asking to add Request.doNotPerform as a modifier element, update reason guidance for requests not to perform something, and document that prohibition can be pre-coordinated in Request.code without double negation.
initial_application: SVN#12969/GF#13468 was applied by git commit 4115024f282744d6be15216875fde9ca94b00280 in source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml, adding the doNotPerform element and requested explanatory text. The current source retained the accepted element and semantics.
additional_context: The R5 CodeableReference refactor in 7daa0d220d80bdaf2229f7aa05f4d4e6c0f5a698 renamed Request.reasonCode/Request.reasonReference to Request.reason but left the FHIR-13468 usage note pointing to reasonCode.text. Active Request-pattern mapping exception files mirrored the stale pattern text, and CommunicationRequest.reason also retained the obsolete textual-reason path. Later issues such as FHIR-11348, FHIR-47394, and FHIR-51848 are artifact-specific doNotPerform decisions rather than reasons to change the pattern semantics here.
reconciliation: Changed the Request.reason usage note to reason.concept.text, corrected doNoPerform to doNotPerform, corrected DNR/resuscitate spelling, updated the Request mapping exception mirrors, and aligned CommunicationRequest.reason with the current CodeableReference path.
source_changes: source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: corrected Request.doNotPerform DNR spelling and Request.reason guidance to reason.concept.text/doNotPerform.
source/communicationrequest/structuredefinition-CommunicationRequest.xml: aligned CommunicationRequest.reason free-text guidance with reason.concept.text.

source/appointment/appointment-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/careplan/careplan-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/communicationrequest/communicationrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/devicerequest/devicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/requestorchestration/requestorchestration-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, source/supplyrequest/supplyrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml, and source/task/task-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated mirrored Request-pattern text to match the corrected source.
